group_members_insert.name: group_members_insert
group_members_insert.withCheck:
is_group_admin("group_members"."group_id", current_setting('app.current_user_id', true))
				or ("group_members"."user_id" = current_setting('app.current_user_id', true) and (
					("group_members"."role" = 'member' and exists (
						select 1 from group_invite_codes c
						where c.group_id = "group_members"."group_id" and c.code = current_setting('app.invite_code', true)
					))
					or ("group_members"."role" = 'owner' and is_group_creator("group_members"."group_id", current_setting('app.current_user_id', true)))
				))

shared_tags_insert.name: shared_tags_insert
shared_tags_insert.withCheck: "shared_tags"."shared_by" = current_setting('app.current_user_id', true) and is_group_member("shared_tags"."group_id", current_setting('app.current_user_id', true))

shared_tags_delete.name: shared_tags_delete
shared_tags_delete.using: "shared_tags"."shared_by" = current_setting('app.current_user_id', true) or is_group_admin("shared_tags"."group_id", current_setting('app.current_user_id', true))

tags_select_in_group.name: tags_select_in_group
tags_select_in_group.using:
exists (
				select 1 from shared_tags st
				join group_members gm on gm.group_id = st.group_id
				where st.tag_id = "tags"."id"
				  and gm.user_id = current_setting('app.current_user_id', true)
			)

user_books_select_in_group.name: user_books_select_in_group
user_books_select_in_group.using:
exists (
				select 1 from user_book_tags ubt
				join shared_tags st on st.tag_id = ubt.tag_id
				join group_members gm on gm.group_id = st.group_id
				where ubt.user_book_id = "user_books"."id"
				  and gm.user_id = current_setting('app.current_user_id', true)
			)

user_books_select_on_loan.using:

			)
